description_en: Batch deletes configurations of accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用BatchDeleteCdnDomainConfig批量删除加速域名的配置
kebab_example: aliyun cdn batch-delete-cdn-domain-config --domain-names example.com,example.org --function-names referer_white_list_set,https_force --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchDeleteCdnDomainConfig

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain names whose configurations you want to delete. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). Note the following limits:
The product of "number of domain names" × "number of functions" must be less than or equal to 20. For example:
If the number of functions configured at a time is 20, you can specify only one domain name at a time.
If the number of functions configured at a time is 1, you can specify up to 20 domain names at a time
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除配置的加速域名，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔。注意以下配置限制：
“域名数量” 乘以 “Functions 数量” 的值小于等于 20。例如：
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为20，那么单次只能传1个域名。
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为1，那么单次可以传20个域名
parameters.name: domain_names

parameters.help_en:
The names of the feature functions that you want to delete. Separate multiple function names with commas (,). Note the following limits:
The product of "number of domain names" × "number of functions" must be less than or equal to 20. For example:
If the number of functions configured at a time is 20, you can specify only one domain name at a time.
If the number of functions configured at a time is 1, you can specify up to 20 domain names at a time.

For more information about feature function names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/388460.html
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的功能函数名称，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔。注意以下配置限制：
“域名数量” 乘以 “Functions 数量” 的值小于等于 20。例如：
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为20，那么单次只能传1个域名。
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为1，那么单次可以传20个域名。

更多功能名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/388460.html
parameters.name: function_names
